item_name: Rothco ANSI Rated Interchangeable Sport Glass Kit
item_short_desc: Rothco ANSI Rated Interchangeable Sport Glass Kit includes three substitutable lenses so you can tailor them to any use. These protective Sport Glasses are great for soldiers, pilots, MilSim enthusiasts, and anybody who enjoys the great outdoors.
description: Meets ANSI-Z87-1 Safety Standard, Black Nylon Frame and Temple, 2.2mm Pc Clear Lens with Interchangeable Yellow and Smoke Grey Lenses, Anti-Fog and Anti-Scratch, Adjustable Elastic Strap for Security, Soft Nose Piece. Comes With Pouch for Storage and Cleaning and Black Zippered Half-Round Hard Case WARNING: This product contains a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects and other reproductive harm.
